scope: P3 create-once store and recovery tests, plus caller-record capture regressions assigned to this TC. This is not full B01 acceptance or a claim about power-loss behavior.

cases.coverage: Independent Node processes publish identical payloads and conflicting payloads for one profile identity; same-content callers both succeed with one final, conflicting content yields one winner and one PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT.
A contender reaches and completes its own directory sync while the first writer is held after link and before its directory sync.

Temp write, file sync, close, link-after-success, directory sync, link-before-underlying-call non-EEXIST failure, and equal-content EEXIST directory-sync failure. Pre-link failures leave no final; ambiguous publication failures report PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN; retry verifies and retains an existing final; cleanup unlink failure leaves publication intact and may leave an ignored temp.

Caller record mutation immediately after publishSnapshot invocation does not alter returned or persisted snapshot. Sparse arrays, custom array properties, symbols, accessors, cycles, and exotic objects reject as SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT before storage I/O; accessor is not evaluated.
initStore parent-directory sync failure returns STORE_IO, leaves a 0700 root, and a normal retry succeeds. Root and published final modes are checked as 0700 and 0600.
An independently sized canonical record exactly 2 MiB including LF is published and read successfully.
Independent worker killed before link leaves an ignored orphan; kills after link/before directory sync and after directory sync/before response both allow exact-byte-preserving verified retry.
Reject symlink root/final, malformed JSON, modified record content, mismatched project identity, and oversized final; failed publish/read does not overwrite corrupt final.

limitations: Only the targeted P3 test file was run; no full npm test/build was run by this TC.
Tests use temporary local filesystem roots and an fs/promises-compatible injected fault seam. They do not establish behavior on network filesystems, Windows, actual power loss, or OS-user isolation.
This ledger records test evidence against the pinned plan and implementation source hashes; it does not constitute final implementation acceptance.
